text:
jordan: spotting high PCIe corrected errors on rack12-host43 for the last ~30m. tail latency p99 jumped ~110ms for some multi-tenant slices. thinking soft-cordon + temporary reserved nodes for the affected tenants. any objections?

infra-bot: ALERT: pcie_crc_errors > threshold on rack12-host43 (host43.rack12.redwood.internal). spike started 2026-03-21T09:02Z.

maria: can you paste the prometheus snippet and which tenants are hitting it? need to scope blast radius.

jordan: query: `increase(node_pcie_crc_errors_total{host="host43"}[15m])` -> 37 in last 15m. impacted: finance-ingest (large batched infer), ad-campaign-sim (short bursts), test/dev namespaces.

kevin: that's concerning. could be flaky retimer/cable or a NIC/PCIe riser. any recent firmware/drivers on that rack?

jordan: nothing in last 48h; last changes were two weeks ago.

jen-sre: ops preference: soft-cordon to stop new placements, migrate tier-1 slices to warm dedicated instances in us-west-2-edge, then triage. avoid mass eviction if possible.

chris: we have 2 spare A100 warm slots in us-west-2-edge. I can pin one for finance-ingest immediately. need to know billing ownership for temporary infra.

maria: infra covers immediate mitigation cost; product team will decide on customer credits after we close PLAT-4231. we must also record per-tenant latency deltas for chargeback.

kevin: triage checklist: 1) soft-cordon host43 (`infractl cordon host43 --soft`) 2) graceful drain best-effort pods (`kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 host/host43`) 3) shift SLA tenants to warm nodes 4) capture `lspci -vvv`, `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,SM,PCI`, and `dmesg`. open RMA if counters keep rising.

jordan: doing cordon now: `./infractl cordon host43 --soft`

infra-bot: ACTION: soft-cordon applied by jordan on host43. new placements suspended.

jordan: listing pods on host43: ~28 pods; ~9 preemptible. starting graceful drain for preemptible ones. will not evict reserved tenant pods.

jen-sre: use warm-pool-swap playbook for migrations. ensure affinity rules prevent finance-ingest landing on preemptible/backfill nodes.

chris: starting playbook for finance-ingest -> reserved-uw2-edge-02. ad-campaign-sim queued second. ETA ~10m.

maria: should we apply egress QoS for the temporary dedicated slices? last ad-campaign-sim incident saturated NVLink and caused cross-host impact.

kevin: yes, enable per-tenant egress shaping (90th percentile + small burst). also tag reserved slices with NVLINK_ISOLATION to prevent sharing noisy NVLink peers.

jordan: tail of dmesg from host43:
```
Mar 21 09:05:12 host43 kernel: pcieport 0000:3c:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: id=00e0
Mar 21 09:05:12 host43 kernel: pcieport 0000:3c:00.0: AER: PCIe Bus Error: severity=Corrected, type=Data Link, id=00e0
Mar 21 09:07:04 host43 kernel: nvidia: GPU 0: ECC single-bit error, address=0x7f9a... count=1
```

jen-sre: looks like link-level corrected errors. could be marginal retimer/cable. ops should plan for physical swap during maintenance window if errors persist.

chris: migration for finance-ingest completed to reserved-uw2-edge-02. ad-campaign-sim started; monitoring.

maria: product alerted and created incident tracker PLAT-4231. cost hold placed pending review.

kevin: remember to gather `nvidia-smi -q` output and GPU/PCIe counters; send to hw-eng and raise RMA if counts don't drop.

jordan: uploaded telemetry: https://s3.redwood.internal/logs/host43/20260321-pcie-ecc.log. current metric after cordon: ~4 errors per 15m, reduced from ~37. infra-bot will re-evaluate in 30m.

infra-bot: MONITOR: pcie_crc_errors trending down after soft-cordon; currently avg=3/15m. next check in 30m.

jen-sre: if it stays >=3/15m for next hour, schedule rack maintenance in 01:00-03:00 UTC window.

maria: assigning actions: jordan monitor+attach metrics to PLAT-4231; chris confirm warm-pool stickiness and egress shaper; kevin collect telemetry + open RMA if needed; jen-sre approve maintenance if persistent.

jordan: will follow up with 30m snapshot. thanks all. :thumbsup:
